session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Buy Climax, Then Bear Channel'. A parabolic wedge buy climax at 5557 fails on lower high double tops, the market chops into a black dotted bear channel; higher high double top at 5533 fails and measured moves sell to 5512 into the close.

events.label: climax
events.outcome_reason: buy climax spike at 5557 ended the opening rally
events.evidence: brown shaded opening wedge with Parabolic Wedge buy climax text and red arrows down from the top

events.label: double_top
events.outcome_reason: lower high double tops under the climax capped all rallies
events.evidence: red Lower high double top(s) text with red arrows across the 08:15-09:20 boxed bars

events.label: channel
events.outcome_reason: black dotted bear channel ground down with capped waves to 5527
events.evidence: black dotted channel lines down the chart to the 11:55 lows and close

events.label: double_top
events.raw_label: Higher high double top (11:55 test of 5533)
events.outcome_reason: HH double top at 5533 failed above the channel and sold to the measured move
events.evidence: red Higher high double top text with green arrows before 12:50 and red arrows after

events.label: measured_move
events.outcome_reason: measured move target 5512 reached at the close lows
events.evidence: orange dotted Measured move line at 5511 and green dotted 5512 with brown shaded close bars
